name: Arnold Classic Africa 2022
information: ### General Information This competition will take place as part of the Arnold Classic Sport Festival. Please note that due to the nature of the festival the venue will be extremely noisy, and this is outside of our control. The competition will be taking place in a large tent, and it is June, so dress warmly. ### Competitor Tickets Please register for the competition and select your events [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArnoldClassicAfrica2022/register), and then pay for your registration at: https://www.quicket.co.za/events/175059-speed-cubing-arnold-classic-africa/#/ Tickets for competitors cost R200, which includes access to the rest of the expo and sport festival. ### Guests Spectators are welcome, but will need to pay for entrance to the expo. Tickets can be bought online through [WebTickets](https://www.webtickets.co.za/v2/EventCategories.aspx?itemid=1513459420) or paid for at the door. Various pricing options are available depending on whether you wish to attend for the whole weekend or just one day. **[Tickets for guests](https://www.webtickets.co.za/v2/EventCategories.aspx?itemid=1513459420)** ### Volunteering We will require volunteers to support with running and judging on the day. If you would like to volunteer to help staff at the competition, please contact the organisers. Groups will be assigned so that volunteer duties don't clash with your competing.
